SystemX Physical Intelligence Summit

Event Details:

Thursday, December 3, 2026
9:00am - 6:00pm PST

Location

Frances C. Arrillaga Alumni Center
Stanford University
United States

This event is open to:

Faculty/Staff
Members
Students

Join us for the Stanford SystemX Physcial Intelligence Summit,  a special event hosted by the Stanford SystemX Alliance.

Date: 09.00-18.00 December 3rd, 2026.
Location: Stanford’s Frances C. Arrillaga Alumni Center, 326 Galvez Street, Stanford, CA 94305, USA.

This summit brings together industry leaders, Stanford faculty, investors, and innovators to examine the next major shift in AI — intelligence moving into the physical world.

Physical Intelligence requires systems that can perceive, reason, and act in real environments, demanding new approaches to learning, reasoning, and system architecture — grounded in physics, shaped by domain constraints, and built for deployment.With support from Analog Devices, Stanford’s SystemX Alliance is convening a select group advancing embodied and embedded AI.The program is structured in two focused parts:

Morning Session: A strategic discussion on value creation, ecosystem needs, and proof points.
Afternoon Technical Program: A deeper look at sensing, physics‑aware learning, edge compute, and the research frontier.

We open with a keynote from Vincent Roche, CEO of Analog Devices, and close with a keynote from Jim Keller, CEO of Tenstorrent.

We invite you to join us! It’s an opportunity to connect with the people shaping the future of Physical Intelligence and contribute to a conversation that is rapidly defining the next era of AI.
